_note: Per-domain authoring contract. Hand-authored source of truth; governed by schemas/domains.json; checked by scripts/validate/validate-domains.js. STEP 4's derive engine will read this.

categories.summary: Component category defaults — anatomy/variants/refs from frontmatter; body mirrored verbatim to dist .md.

foundations.summary: Foundations guidance — body parsed into a Pattern-H section tree; also emits a verbatim foundations.md mirror.

accessibility.summary: WCAG guidance — body parsed into a Pattern-H section tree (same engine as foundations).

guidelines.summary: Per-component guidelines — body domains (content/usage/design/behavior) parsed into sections + kept verbatim per-domain; frontmatter in sibling _meta.yml (+tokens.yml).

app-context/apps.summary: App-context apps — body parsed into H2/H3 sections.

app-context/entities.summary: App-context entities — body normalized verbatim into a single description field.

app-context/patterns.summary: App-context patterns — body normalized verbatim into a single description field.

content/global.summary: Global content/writing guidance — bodies copied verbatim into global.md. NOTE: frontmatterSchema gap (closed in a later STEP-3 slice).

content/patterns.summary: Content pattern files — parsed into sections and fanned out (appended) into component guideline records.

graph.summary: Knowledge graph — derived from dist artifacts; no markdown body.

tokens.summary: Design tokens — hand-authored data file; no markdown body. NOTE: frontmatterSchema gap (closed in a later STEP-3 slice).

canonical-sections.summary: Canonical design-section catalogue — JSON→JSON projection; no markdown body.
